label: alpha-chymotrypsin activity
definition: A phenotype in which a microorganism exhibits chymotrypsin-like serine endopeptidase activity, preferentially cleaving peptide bonds on the carboxyl side of tyrosine, tryptophan, phenylalanine, or leucine residues.
observations: Follow-up from the physiology diagnostic-enzyme gap sweep; absent from METPO and TraitMech after an alpha-chymotrypsin duplicate review covering ignored and hidden files.
